mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id, member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status, created_at FROM attendance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND work_date = DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)), DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), NULL, '근무중' )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET end_time = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), status = '퇴근' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND work_date = DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) AND end_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id, member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status, created_at FROM attendance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND today_attendance.start_time IS NOT NULL AND today_attendance.end_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS working_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND today_attendance.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS finished_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND today_attendance.member_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS absent_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS vacation_count
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, MAX(start_time) AS start_time, MAX(end_time) AS end_time FROM attendance WHERE work_date = DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) GROUP BY member_id ) today_attendance ON today_attendance.member_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM vacation WHERE status = '승인' AND DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ) vacation_member ON vacation_member.member_id = m.id

SELECT a.attendance_id AS attendanceId, m.id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, #{date} AS workDate, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime,
CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'VACATION' WHEN a.start_time IS NULL THEN 'ABSENT' WHEN a.end_time IS NULL THEN 'WORKING' ELSE 'FINISHED' END AS status
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.member_id = m.id AND a.work_date = #{date}
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM vacation WHERE status = '승인' AND #{date} BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ) vacation_member ON vacation_member.member_id = m.id
WHERE m.enabled = 'Y'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN a.start_time IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN a.end_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, m.name ASC

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND selected_attendance.start_time IS NOT NULL AND selected_attendance.end_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS working_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND selected_attendance.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS finished_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND selected_attendance.member_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS absent_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS vacation_count
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, MAX(start_time) AS start_time, MAX(end_time) AS end_time FROM attendance WHERE work_date = #{date} GROUP BY member_id ) selected_attendance ON selected_attendance.member_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM vacation WHERE status = '승인' AND #{date} BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ) vacation_member ON vacation_member.member_id = m.id
WHERE m.enabled = 'Y'
SELECT attendance_id, member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status, created_at FROM attendance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND work_date = #{workDate} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{workDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ABSENT' THEN '결근' WHEN #{status} = 'WORKING' THEN '근무중' WHEN #{status} = 'FINISHED' THEN '퇴근' ELSE #{status} END )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ABSENT' THEN '결근' WHEN #{status} = 'WORKING' THEN '근무중' WHEN #{status} = 'FINISHED' THEN '퇴근' ELSE #{status} END WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND work_date = #{workDate}
